scenario_assignment: For each role/family, (local_world_index + family_index) % 4; all worlds assigned roles/families/scenarios before sampled events or labels.
source_schema_notes: One synthetic source/world. branch_id=source. source_id/world/group/subject namespaces include version and seed. Header carries no hidden rule/state parameters.

event_text.json_serialization: canonical_json; fact object exactly name,value; one RULE event and one FACT event per required field

query_template: At observation cutoff {cutoff}, {query_body}. If a required field is unavailable, {missing_instruction}.
ask_field_order: RULE first, followed by family fact_fields order, only missing fields
support_order: All active observed events in original chronological (observed_at,event_id) order; no target/oracle or future events. Correction/tombstone removes predecessor.

register_xor8.query_body: compute INPUT XOR MASK using the observed rule

affine_mod97.query_body: compute the affine result using the observed rule

finite_state.query_body: report the final state after consuming SYMBOLS from START using the observed transition rule

rule.consume: SYMBOLS left to right starting at START
rule.transitions: per-world object of S0..S3 to objects a,b mapping to S0..S3; each symbol is a permutation

finite_state.corrected_value: next START in cyclic state list

tool_recovery.query_body: recommend the next operation for fictional tool lookup using the observed retry rule
tool_recovery.corrected_value: change STATUS so the recommendation changes; independent generator calculates it
tool_recovery.scope: Static next-operation recommendation only; target.action=answer, no executed tool call.

semantic_duplicate_signature: Normalize rule/fact event texts, event/observation times, operations and predecessor positions; exclude source/world/persona/role/event IDs. Reject duplicates across the entire release.
exposure: All role packets are public inspected synthetic contract material. Promotion/audit are exposed fixtures, not sealed scientific benchmarks.
generalization_scope: World/source groups disjoint; four mechanisms and grammar shared across roles. No unseen-mechanism/family generalization claim.
tokenizer: Reuse checkpoints/minicpm5_source offline; measure native full/prompt/support/answer/EOS views; max512 admission, reject without truncation.
review: At least20 cases per family×scenario critical stratum, independent raw-source solve; log chosen IDs/rejections and within-world clustering.

native_generation_preflight.selection: 4 independent worlds per family with one representative query per scenario; fixed before any native generation, action-balanced overall
native_generation_preflight.source: same sealed original B1 evidence-matched frozen reference
